A deep charcoal triceratops with amber crystal horns, glowing orange lines in its stone-like frill and restrained ember flecks, grounded strong pose. Anatomy: Quadrupedal triceratops dinosaur with broad rounded neck frill, two long brow horns and one short nose horn, beaked snout, sturdy body and tapering tail; exactly four legs. Match the previously viewed BlitzWord references and tiger/phoenix/octopus concepts: sophisticated warm painted storybook fantasy, fine gouache brushwork, natural animal proportions, believable textured materials, charming expressive eyes, dimensional shading. Full creature centered on warm cream parchment, three-quarter view facing left with all extremities comfortably inside frame and generous margins. Simple soft grounding shadow, no environment, no other animals. Restrained thin botanical border. Caption in small dark brown serif type below, exactly "Triceratops B · Elemental". Maintain natural animal body, no humanoid limbs. Avoid chibi, anime, plastic 3D, photorealism, busy effects, excessive armour, weapons and cropped extremities. A single square selection card, NOT a sheet or collage.
